newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-TOP FRENCH PLAYER OUT FOR SIX MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-TOP FRENCH PLAYER OUT FOR SIX MONTHS.

text.p: France's top player Antoine Rigaudeau will be out for the rest of the season with an elbow injury, missing his club Pau-Orthez's remaining EuroLeague games.

Rigaudeau, who broke down in training on Thursday after coming back from the injury to his right elbow suffered in November, will also miss the final phase of the European nations championship in Spain.

The injury blow, which means an operation next week and six months out of action, could end Rigaudeau's hopes of a move to a big foreign club next season. European champions Panathinaikos of Greece have shown interest in the French playmaker.
